hs-00-n.text:
shared

The parts every screen is built from: the logo, the cat mascot, type, colour, buttons and fields, the chips for the types a call returns, the four states every panel has, and the frame that streams a program’s machine live with watch and take control.

used by every simple page and every MCP panel

States, top to bottom: logo, mascot, type, colour, buttons and fields, return types, waiting, empty, loading, error, live stream: watching, in control, ended.
Each state: the page at any width (opens full screen on desktop and iPad), and the phone at 390.

hs-02-n.text:
simple page

The one way in. Google or GitHub, no passwords. Opened from Claude’s first call, from the home page, or from an invite; it hands you back to wherever you came from.

served by the server at glyphh.ai/signin · opened from a link or inline where the harness allows

States, top to bottom: sign in, loading, signed in, refused, error.
Each state: the page at any width (opens full screen on desktop and iPad), and the phone at 390.

hs-03-n.text:
simple page

A harness asks to use your Glyphh. You see which one, pick the org it acts in, and allow or deny. Claude is drawn; Codex, Gemini and any other harness get the same page with their name.

served by the server at glyphh.ai/allow · OAuth consent for a harness

States, top to bottom: allow, choosing the org, connected, not connected, expired.
Each state: the page at any width (opens full screen on desktop and iPad), and the phone at 390.

hs-04-n.text:
simple page

Subscribe to a plan, add funds, or change the card. The card fields are Stripe’s Payment Element dressed in Glyphh’s fields, so card numbers never touch Glyphh.

served by the server at glyphh.ai/pay · Stripe’s Payment Element styled to the look · opened from Billing or a needs-funds link

States, top to bottom: subscribe, add funds, change the card, processing, the bank’s check, paid, refused, error.
Each state: the page at any width (opens full screen on desktop and iPad), and the phone at 390.

returned as a panel by Glyphh’s MCP server · drawn in Claude at the harness’s panel width (760) and on a phone

hs-11-n.text:
MCP panel

A sentence becomes a program: its parts appear as they are made (models, connections, functions, tasks, folders, browsers), the checks prove it does the same thing every time, and it ends with its manifest.js validated and the program installed, insulated, on your machine, its tools in the harness. Built wherever you build; Claude is drawn.

returned while a program is built from any harness · Claude drawn · panel width 760 and phone

States, top to bottom: the plan, making the parts, the checks, needs auth, ready, a check failed.
Each state: the page at any width (opens full screen on desktop and iPad), and the phone at 390.

hs-12-n.text:
MCP panel

A program called from anywhere runs one of its tasks step by step, each step a function on its models, connections, folders and browsers, and streams its machine live into the conversation. You can watch, or take control and give it back; it stops only to ask for what it can’t do without you.

what a call returns while a program runs · every type drawn: working, panel, needs input, needs auth, result, error · Claude drawn

States, top to bottom: working + live stream, taken control, needs input, needs auth, working, check back, result, error.
Each state: the page at any width (opens full screen on desktop and iPad), and the phone at 390.

hs-12b-n.text:
MCP panel

Everything a program is made of, on one page: what it does, its models, connections, functions, tasks and schedules, its folders and browsers, who can call it, its manifest.js (how it runs and what it’s made of) and what it did lately. Installed, insulated, on your own machine; you change it by asking.

a program’s own page, in the harness · was a super power · Claude drawn · panel width 760 and phone

States, top to bottom: a program, a task, changing it, who can call it, recent runs, loading, error.
Each state: the page at any width (opens full screen on desktop and iPad), and the phone at 390.
